discrepancyAccounting.description: Candidate scale500-tmdb-10220 failed writer structural repair due to COPY_TOO_LONG, entered terminal state STRUCTURAL_QUARANTINED, and never executed risk-verifiers. It has no frozen risk-input.json. The reconnaissance formula (150 - 33 = 117) counted all 150 cohort records, whereas only 149 records generated risk-inputs (149 - 33 = 116).

Eight untouched candidates in Tranche 2 risk-verifiers were historically adjudicated by Sophia in the Pilot human review (human-review-decisions.completed.v1.json) and used as test fixtures in editorialPilot.mjs/editorialPilot.test.mjs. Under the mandatory conservative exposure policy, these 8 candidates are strictly excluded (116 - 8 = 108).

notes: The discrepancy between 193 and 184 reflects mechanical discovery of one structurally quarantined candidate lacking risk input and conservative firewalling of eight pilot fixtures. There is zero exposure contamination in the remaining 184 eligible records.
